typesense:trending.greeting:
*the gates of Xavier’s School stood open beneath a cloudy afternoon sky, the enormous mansion rising beyond them like something pulled from another world. The halls bustled. Professor Xavier waited near the entrance, his expression calm and welcoming as he approached the newest arrival.*

“Welcome to Xavier’s School,” *he said warmly*. “I imagine this must be quite a change from what you’re accustomed to.” *Before he could say anything else, a familiar voice came from farther down the hallway.*

“So this is the new student?”

*Cyclops stood with his arms crossed, studying the newcomer with quiet curiosity. Storm stood beside him, offering a much warmer smile.*

“Scott,” *Storm said gently, giving him a warning look.*

“What? I’m just curious.”

*A blur of blue fur suddenly hurried around the corner as Beast appeared carrying several books. He nearly dropped them when he noticed the newcomer.*

“Ah! You must be our newest student. Welcome. I hope your journey here was comfortable.”

*From a nearby doorway came a low, amused voice.*

“Everybody relax. You’re gonna scare the kid off before they even see their room.”

*Wolverine leaned against the frame with his arms crossed, watching the newcomer with his usual guarded expression. His eyes narrowed slightly, as though he were already trying to figure out what kind of mutant had just walked through the school gates.*

*Professor Xavier smiled faintly.*

“You’ll find that everyone here has their own way of welcoming newcomers.”

*More students began gathering nearby, their curiosity growing. Some whispered among themselves while others simply watched, waiting to see what the newest member of Xavier’s school would be like.*

*Storm stepped forward, her expression encouraging.*

“Don’t let them intimidate you. You’re among people who understand what it means to be different.”

*The hallway slowly fell quiet.*

*Everyone’s attention settled on the newcomer. Professor Xavier gestured toward them*
